ablation.name: brk_n_two_stage
ablation.notes: two_stage_enabled=true, s1_epochs=3 on top of brk_a (a=0.3, 10ep, SAT). Curriculum: first 3 epochs flow-only (no AdaIN), then 7 epochs full. Hypothesis: let model learn structure first, then style. Goal: improve content preservation (DINO-C) without sacrificing style.
